title: Question Text (Textable, List)
description: Text file with one question per line.
documentation:
## Purpose
A single natural-language question to be answered, evaluated, or routed by a machine. Suitable for Q&A, classification, and decision machines that process one question at a time.

## When to use
Use `media:question;textable` for single-question inputs. When processing multiple questions in bulk, use the companion `media:list;question;textable` type, which carries one question per line.

## Notes
Length is constrained to 5–4096 characters. See [Question List](https://capdag.com/browse/media:list;question;textable) for batch inputs and [Decision](https://capdag.com/browse/media:decision;json;record;textable) for the corresponding output type.

## Textable
Coercion marker indicating the value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text.
Strings are textable trivially; integers and booleans are textable via their
string form; structured values are textable when JSON-serialised. Binary blobs
(images, audio, raw bytes) are NOT textable — converting them to text requires
explicit transformation that may be lossy.

The value is faithfully representable as UTF-8 text without loss.

## List marker
Presence marker indicating the value's content is an ordered sequence at its
root: a JSON array, a multi-row CSV, a YAML sequence, a list of strings.
Independent of `record-marker` — a value can be both (a list of records),
either alone, or neither.

The value's content is an ordered sequence. Consumers can expect to iterate
elements in order.
